hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *'rm -rf'* || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *'git push --force'* || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *'git reset --hard'* ]]; then echo 'BLOCKED: destructive command detected'; exit 2; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" == *'answers/'* ]]; then echo 'Heads-up: answers/ is read-mostly; confirm before editing.'; fi
if echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -E '\.(py)$'; then python -m ruff format $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || python -m black $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -E '\.(py)$'; then python -m py_compile $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if echo $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS | grep -E '\.(ipynb)$'; then nbstripout $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS 2>/dev/null || true; fi
